info.title: Weaver project machine API
info.description: Project-owned bearer keys with independent Read/Create/Update/Delete grants. Folder grants cover descendants and future content. Markdown only. Table replacement also requires Create for added rows and Delete for removed rows, columns or options. HEAD grants revision access for applicable actions. Every mutation requires Idempotency-Key; item mutations require If-Match. JSON bodies are limited to 5 MiB.
